spec.assertion: Structural: the heal-carrying skill1 block's trigger is hitCount with count 3. Fails under the nearest-wrong shotFired / interval / everyN-on-shotFired keyings. The payload itself is engine-unobservable (no heal event kind), so trigger identity is pinned on the model shape rather than the event log.

Structural target is alliesOfClass/Supporter, PLUS the discriminating behavioural pair: stripping every heal is byte-identical to base, while widening the same blocks to {kind:'allies'} is NOT. Under the nearest-wrong 'allies' scope both assertions invert, because the fixture's B2 is an on-recovery consumer outside the Supporter scope.

A heal effect must exist on skill1 (guards the 'heals are defensive, skip them' failure mode, which would silence on-recovery consumers). Also asserts 6.07 never appears as a buff value — the magnitude must not be smuggled onto a damage-bearing stat. The HP amount and the lifesteal-over-5s tick shape are it.skip (no HP pool; tick count is an unstated authoring choice).

No StatKey exists for Incoming Healing. Asserts 23.46 appears in NO buffApply and on NO effect value/atkPct anywhere in the override — i.e. it was not parked on atkPct/attackDamagePct to avoid a blank line. Fails under any mis-encoding; passes only if the line is genuinely unmodeled.
it.skip — the v1 boss deals no damage so HP is pinned at 100%; the gate is trivially always true and carries no observable consequence.
it.skip for trigger identity (lastBullet) — the effect it would carry has no StatKey, so a correct and an incorrect trigger are indistinguishable.

The expensive nearest-wrong is reading an 'affects all enemies ▼78.93%' line as damageTakenPct, which would be a ~79% team-wide damage amplifier. Asserts no boss-held debuff (casterIdx===null && targetIdx===null) and no buffApply at all carries 78.93, and that no effect in the override uses damageTakenPct.

Every 77.22-valued buffApply carries stat atkPct (raw percentage), discriminating it from casterAtkPct / atkOfCasterMaxHpPct, which flat-resolve at apply time and would emit a five-figure ATK number. Duration semantics pinned by counterfactual: durationSec 10->2 strictly lowers every beneficiary's total, so the window is real seconds and load-bearing.

Beneficiary slugs from the buffApply log never include the caster (a Supporter), and the block's target is alliesOfClass/Attacker. Non-vacuity: retargeting the same block to {kind:'allies'} changes totals, proving the fixture contains a non-Attacker ally whose damage the wrong scope would move.

Trigger identity is burstCast, not fullBurstEnter. She is a Burst II sharing the stage with the fixture's own B2, so she does not cast on every rotation; re-keying the block to fullBurstEnter over-credits the buff on rotations the other B2 completed, and totals must differ. Backed by a structural trigger.kind check.

A heal effect must exist on the burst slot, and NO buff effect may use casterMaxHpPct / targetMaxHpPct / atkOfCasterMaxHpPct / maxHpPct / maxHpFlat, nor carry the value 38.61. Nearest-wrong: reading 'restores HP equal to 38.61% of the skill user's final Max HP' as a Max-HP or HP-scaled-ATK GRANT, which would feed HP-scaling ATK consumers that a one-shot restore never touches.
it.skip (no death/revive model; nobody is incapacitated at scope lock), backed by a live assertion that the unmodeled record matches /reviv/i — the no-silent-drops audit trail.

No flatDamage / dot / hitRepeat / storedHit / stackedNuke effect anywhere in the override. Guards against a fabricated damage source filling in for the three unmodellable heal/Incoming-Healing lines. Plus strict per-slug inertness: removing all heals leaves every unit's total bit-identical, not just the aggregate.

fixtures: controlComp('anne-miracle-fairy', true) only — one comp, six hoisted 180 s runs (base + 5 counterfactuals: heals stripped, heals widened to allies, burst ATK widened to allies, burst ATK durationSec 10->2, burst ATK re-keyed to fullBurstEnter). The fixed B3 slot is KEPT so the chain completes and Full Bursts actually occur (she is a Burst II and cannot complete a chain herself). Sharing the B2 stage with the fixture's own B2 is deliberate, not an accident: it is what makes burstCast distinguishable from fullBurstEnter, and it is what puts an on-recovery consumer OUTSIDE both of her heal class-scopes so the strip/widen pair discriminates the scope. A first `it` asserts fixture non-vacuity (Full Bursts occur AND she casts at least once) so a fixture failure localizes there instead of masquerading as a model failure. Deterministic, no seed.
gaps: burst 'Revives with 99% HP / once per battle' — it.skip: no death or revive primitive, and nobody is ever incapacitated at scope lock. Recorded in unmodeled instead (asserted).

skill1 '6.07% of attack damage ... lasts for 5 sec' — it.skip on the amount/tick shape: no HP pool, no heal amount on any event, and whether the 5 s window emits one recovery pulse or repeated ticks is an authoring choice (⚑) the kit text does not settle.
skill2 'Incoming Healing ▲ 23.46%' — it.skip: no StatKey for Incoming Healing. Only the negative (not mis-encoded onto a damage stat) is assertable.
skill2 'Incoming Healing ▼ 78.93% for 10 sec' — it.skip: same missing StatKey, and the boss never heals so the debuff has no consumer. Only the negative (not encoded as damageTakenPct) is assertable.

skill2 'above 90% HP' self-gate and the lastBullet trigger — it.skip: the boss deals no damage so HP is pinned at 100% (gate trivially true), and the gated payload is unobservable, so a correct trigger and a wrong one are indistinguishable here.
